title: RESILIOUS — Building Europe’s Internet Resilience for a Connected Future
description: PI at QMUL. A Doctoral Network developing resilient Internet infrastructure across terrestrial, satellite and submarine systems, alongside cybersecurity, governance and standardisation.

title: Neighbourhood Signals — Online Discussions and Crime
description: PI. Studies whether hyperlocal online discussions can provide early indicators of offline crime by linking longitudinal social-platform data with police-reported crime and socio-demographic data.

title: Fediverse Observatory
description: PI. Developed an observatory providing researchers and policymakers with data and tools for studying harms, moderation and other dynamics across the Fediverse.

title: DSNmod — Moderation in Decentralised Social Networks
description: PI. Studied content moderation in decentralised social networks and developed approaches for moderation across independent servers, including federated learning.

title: AP4L — Adaptive PETs to Protect & emPower People during Life Transitions
description: Co-I. A multidisciplinary project developing privacy-enhancing technologies to protect people from online harms during major life transitions.

title: SoDeStream — Streamlining Social Decision Making for Improved Internet Standards
description: Co-I. Studied decision-making in Internet standardisation using natural language processing, social network analysis and Internet measurement.
